an4.128:1.1: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavanti.
an4.128:1.4: sā Tathāgatena anālaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūyati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti.
an4.128:1.5: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 2.
an4.128:2.2: sā Tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūyati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti.
an4.128:2.3: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 3.
an4.128:3.2: sā Tathāgatena opasamike dhamme sussūyati . . . upaṭṭhāpeti.
an4.128:3.3: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave . . . pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 4.
an4.128:4.2: sā Tathāgatassa avijjāvinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūyati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti.
an4.128:4.3: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:4.4: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro abbhutā dhammā pātubhāvantīti. 129.2 1.
